items.headline: G: $650M raise to scale inference cloud toward 200 MW by 2027
items.summary: G announced $650M new growth capital to expand GroqCloud, including fit-out scaling toward ~200 MW by end of 2027. It cited 13 data centers, 5M+ developers, and trillions of tokens weekly.
